title: Crowds without waves: every way, own pace, stops and pairs
caption: From your note on the phone: "they come in waves and all walk the same way, it feels a bit artificial". New people now set off at random gaps instead of in a rush (also after a scene), every period has people going against the commute and across it, everyone walks at their own pace, some stop on the way (a phone, a shop window, a shoe, a word together) and some walk in twos. Strips: the same phone view in the morning, one frame every 3 seconds, before and after.

images.caption: Before: a bunch of four walking the same way together, then an empty street, then the next bunch
After: people spread out, some toward the head office, some away from it or across
Before: three walking in step toward the head office, then one at a time. Over a minute, nine in ten walkers here headed west
After: one or two crossing at a time, different ways, next to a pair talking. Over a minute, about half headed west

sections.title: Stops and pairs up close
sections.caption: Taken with every walker set to stop, so there is one in view; in the game 15 to 40% of walkers stop once, depending on the place and time.
